text.p: Genesis Insurance & Financial Services Inc said on Tuesday that it had second quarter earnings over $720,000 on sales of over $5 million.
The company said the earnings growth, which increased 90 percent over the previous quarter, reflected a change to accrual accounting from cash basis accounting.
Genesis also said that results of previously acquired subsidiaries were included in the figures.
The earnings release had been delayed by the increased workload on its independent auditors, Genesis said. Third quarter earnings were due out in seven to 10 days, it said.

Company Chief Executive Officer Mohamed Khairy Mohamed Zayed said year-end results would increase dramatically due to anticipated acquisitions and revenue growth. He said the company planned to launch a $1 million investor-relations compaign effective this week.
